category.name: OfficeMath
category.preferred_workflow: Always employ the deterministic EQ-field bootstrap pattern: insert a FieldEquation, write a safe EQ argument into the field separator, update the field, call AsOfficeMath to obtain a real OfficeMath node, insert the node before the field start, and then remove the field. Operate on top-level OfficeMath nodes (MathObjectType.OMathPara) for display-type and justification changes, and create any required source documents locally within the example.

strict_api_bans: Do not call any API that is not part of Aspose.Words.Math, such as InsertMathObject, MathParser, or LoadMathML.
canonical_patterns: Use only the documented properties DisplayType, Justification, and MathObjectType on top-level OfficeMath nodes.
nullable_warning_prevention: Check for null after AsOfficeMath and before inserting or replacing nodes to avoid NullReferenceException.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compiler errors for unknown types such as InsertMathObject or LoadMathML.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Code attempts to use non-existent helper methods that are not part of the Aspose.Words API.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Replace the invented calls with the documented EQ-field bootstrap sequence.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Reference only the APIs listed in the official Aspose.Words.Math documentation.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compiler errors for members like OfficeMath.Start or IsInline.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Incorrect property or method names that do not exist on the OfficeMath class.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use only the valid members DisplayType, Justification, and MathObjectType.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the Aspose.Words.Math reference to verify member names before coding.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime exceptions when setting DisplayType or Justification on nested OfficeMath nodes.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Attempting to modify display mode on equations that are not top-level OMathPara objects.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Restrict DisplayType and Justification changes to nodes where MathObjectType equals OMathPara.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Filter OfficeMath nodes by MathObjectType before applying formatting properties.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime failures such as "Cannot insert a null node" during replacement or insertion.
common_failure_patterns.cause: AsOfficeMath returned null because the EQ field failed to convert.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Verify that AsOfficeMath returns a non-null OfficeMath instance before insertion or replacement.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Add explicit null checks and throw informative errors if conversion fails.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime errors caused by attempts to load non-existent files or folders.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Examples assumed the presence of external DOCX files, streams, or directories.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Create all required sample documents, folders, and streams programmatically within the example.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Never rely on external assets; generate them locally at runtime.

narrative.overview: The OfficeMath category addresses the handling of mathematical equations represented by Aspose.Words.OfficeMath nodes within Word documents. Verified examples illustrate loading, enumerating, inserting, justifying, cloning, and replacing OfficeMath objects using the native EQ-field bootstrap workflow.
narrative.purpose: Supply concise, reproducible code snippets that generate realistic DOCX inputs, convert EQ fields to genuine OfficeMath nodes, and perform supported operations such as enumeration, justification, insertion, cloning, and replacement while conforming to Aspose.Words 26.10.0 APIs.
validation_priorities: Validate that each generated document contains at least one top-level OfficeMath node and that its Justification matches the expected value.
maintenance_notes: Preserve the EQ-field bootstrap sequence unchanged and update sample EQ arguments only when new equation types are explicitly required.
